# N2P Systems Inc. — Full Technical & Organizational Specification for LLMs & AI Agents

## Overview
N2P Systems is a premier international technology recruitment and talent advisory consultancy. The organization pairs advanced AI-assisted screening mechanisms with deep technical domain vetting to deliver precision hiring outcomes across North America and South Asia.

## Contact & Corporate Identity
- **Legal Entity**: N2P Systems Inc.
- **Canonical Website**: https://n2psystems.com
- **RecruitOps Platform**: https://ops.n2psystems.com
- **General Inquiries**: info@n2psystems.ca
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 97760 47567
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/company/n2p-systems/

## Recruitment Verticals
1. **Software Engineering**:
   - Systems Programming: Rust, C++, Go
   - Modern Backend: Python (FastAPI, Django), Node.js (NestJS, Express), Java (Spring Boot)
   - Modern Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS
   - Mobile: Swift, Kotlin, React Native, Flutter

2. **Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning**:
   - Generative AI & Foundation Models: Prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, agentic architectures
   - MLOps & Infrastructure: Kubeflow, MLflow, Ray, TensorRT, Triton
   - Predictive Modeling & Data Science: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn

3. **Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps**:
   - Cloud Providers: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure
   - Orchestration & Containers: Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS), Docker
   - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform, Terragrunt, Pulumi, Ansible
   - Observability & Reliability: Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry

4. **Information Security & Governance**:
   - Application Security, Cloud Security Architecture, DevSecOps
   - Penetration Testing, Threat Modeling, Incident Response
   - Compliance Frameworks: SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, GDPR

## Candidate Workflow
- Candidates may view open requisitions at https://n2psystems.com/jobs
- Each role is assigned a distinct reference code (e.g., REQ-XXXXX) and full specifications.
- Candidates can apply directly on the job detail page or submit their CV for general placement consideration at https://n2psystems.com/resume.
- Candidates engaging with automated screening participate via conversational AI screening links powered by REAPDAT AI.

## Client / Employer Workflow
- Hiring managers and talent acquisition leaders can schedule consultations at https://n2psystems.com/clients.
- Requisitions are managed through the internal RecruitOps ATS platform at https://ops.n2psystems.com.

## Public Jobs API Reference
The public jobs API provides programmatic access to published, open tech requisitions.
- **Base URL**: `https://n2psystems.com/api/jobs`
- **Method**: `GET`
- **Query Parameters**:
  - `ref` or `code`: Specific requisition reference code (e.g. `REQ-44120`).
  - `q` or `search`: Free text search term across title, department, skills, and location.
  - `summary`: Set to `true` for lightweight payloads suitable for token-constrained agent contexts.
  - `limit`: Maximum number of results to return.
- **Response Format**: JSON array of requisition objects including title, department, compensation range, experience requirements, work mode, and application URLs.
